goal: Minimum total cost from 1 to n using exactly k directed edges; -1 if impossible
loops_and_parallel_edges: Neither is prohibited by the statement; preserve actual loops and minimize parallel costs
API_extensions: n=1, m=0, m>n*(n-1), k=0 are never counted as official-domain cases
safety: Final unused square has at most 2^30 edges: magnitude <=2^30*10^9 <2^119; sentinel is -2^120; finite requested answer <=10^18
